ciMeasurements.runner: ubuntu-latest (GitHub Actions), node 22, workflow run 43168737492 (both checks and performance-gate jobs succeeded)
ciMeasurements.configuration: node --max-old-space-size=1024 (same controlled heap as the local gate)
ciMeasurements.history: The uncapped CI measurement (run 43064704274) failed peak RSS at ~1.22-1.25GB; see gate.investigation for the root-cause breakdown (node version + platform memory accounting) and the rejected MALLOC_ARENA_MAX alternative.
ciMeasurements.ratification: Approved by Lei Han on 2026-11-12: the performance-gate CI job became blocking after the controlled-heap configuration passed on ubuntu-latest with ~114MB peak-RSS margin (median 29196ms vs the 60000ms threshold).

investigation.trigger: First fixed-CI measurement showed peak RSS ~1.22-1.25GB vs the 1GiB threshold while elapsed passed comfortably.
investigation.method: Isolated the two variables (node version, OS) with a standalone node v22.23.5 on darwin and a node:22 docker container reproducing the CI measurement, plus heap-cap probes. Semantic artifacts were byte-compared for every configuration.

measurements.config: darwin, node 25.5.0, default heap (repo gate, post-hotpath-fix)

measurements.note: platform costs ~+100-150MB over darwin; CI's own runner measured ~1227-1252MB (kernel/accounting differences on GitHub runners add more)

rootCauses: node version: node 22's V8 heap growth policy keeps more heap resident than node 25 for the same workload
platform: linux memory accounting and allocator behavior add ~100-150MB on top; GitHub-hosted runners measured higher still than a local linux container
investigation.decision: The gate now measures under a fixed 1GiB V8 old-space cap (--max-old-space-size=1024). Rationale: node's default old-space limit scales with host RAM, so an uncapped measurement is not reproducible across machines or node versions; the cap is GC policy only and semantic artifacts were byte-identical in every tested configuration (node 25/node 22, darwin/linux). MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=1 was tested and rejected (worse memory and wall time).
investigation.ciCappedRuns: to be recorded from the next performance-gate CI run; the job stays continue-on-error until CI numbers are recorded and thresholds explicitly ratified
